name: Pedro Perestrelo Family Life
source: This game is about family life, our hero very beautiful and highly depraved character. The player can either develop a family relationship, and get a happy family, or indulge in debauchery with every diverse neighbors and friends. And if he did not have any morality, he may take the corruption of their own daughters and their girlfriends, or even dive into such corruption from which there is no way out, that's when main hero certainly no joy his future fate.​
translation: 这是一款关于家庭生活的游戏，主角相貌出众，却也极其放荡。玩家既可以经营家人之间的关系，拥有一个幸福的家庭，也可以与形形色色的邻居和朋友纵情享乐。如果他毫无道德底线，还可能让自己的女儿们和她们的朋友一起堕落，甚至陷入再也无法回头的腐败深渊。到了那时，主角未来的命运，恐怕就再无快乐可言。
